## Job details
Education: Secondary (high) school graduation certificate. or equivalent experience. Work site environment: Non-smoking. Outdoors. Noisy. Confined spaces. Hot. Tasks: Drive and operate ramp-servicing vehicles and equipment. Position passenger loading stairs and operate aircraft cargo doors. Marshall or tow aircraft to gate positions. Unload, sort and route cargo and passenger baggage. Transport freight between aircraft and airport warehouse. Clean and prepare aircraft interior for passengers and wash aircraft exterior. Vehicle and equipment experience: Towing tractors. Lavatory servicing trucks. Aircraft cargo doors. Passenger loading stairs. Security and safety: Criminal record check. Airport security clearance. Driver's validity licence check. Medical exam. Transportation/travel information: Valid driver's licence. Driver's abstract. Work conditions and physical capabilities: Fast-paced environment. Work under pressure. Physically demanding. Tight deadlines. Attention to detail. Combination of sitting, standing, walking. Bending, crouching, kneeling. Weight handling: More than 45 kg (100 lbs). Own tools/equipment: Steel-toed safety boots. Personal suitability: Dependability. Excellent oral communication. Flexibility. Organized. Reliability. Team player. Employment terms options: Early morning. Evening. Shift. Flexible hours. Morning. Night. Experience: Will train. Employment terms options: Day. Weekend. Overtime required. Overtime available.
